prerequisites: dedicated provider namespace and fresh prepared agent scope
verified OAuth account and explicit action/resource selection
API, worker, queue, vault and private object store configured
independent read-only provider record and request audit access

cases.expectedOutcome: Verified account, selected calendar, exact intended scopes and IANA time zone; reconnect returns to the same agent.
Availability-only policy offers permitted slots without booking reserve tool or booking.execute grant; any direct reserve attempt produces no intent or provider write.
Exact customer confirmation, one matching event and confirmed native receipt.
Missing, rejected, expired, changed or wrong-session approval creates no event.
Busy/conflicting slot creates no event; stable invocation retry creates no duplicate.
At most one create; status reconciliation confirms same event or retains uncertainty.
DST/offset and selected resource agree with policy; revoked permission prevents sends.
Exact approved contact fields; one new record or zero creates for an already matching record; no customer-record disclosure.
Unapproved, mismatched, expired, wrong-session or human-owned intake does not write; customer contacts.search denied.
Exact-email, permitted account, bounded field projection and zero create requests.
Stable invocation does not create again; unknown effects remain uncertain; revoked authority prevents new sends.

limitations: No automatic customer decision in KasitekAgent
No new AGENTS_HARBOR_SUITE selector or provider-specific independent verifier
Native export completeness does not establish a successful write or live vendor acceptance
